title: State of the MIKE Economy - Q2 2025
blurb: Stabilization quarter following Q1 employment transition. PPI flat at 98.75, PWI recovered +6.5% to 59.3.
summary: Stabilization quarter following Q1 employment transition. PPI flat at 98.75 (stable productivity averaging 97.92), PWI recovered +6.5% to 59.3 (volatile April spike from shareholder purchase), Longform Media Velocity strong at 12 points/month average. Foundation solidified with contract work focus and consistent intellectual engagement.

ppi.note: June value (98.75). Stable quarter averaging 97.92: content wind-down (Apr 97.5), workflow stabilization (May 97.5), contract work intensive period (Jun 98.75). Flat performance vs Q1 ending.

knowledge-expansion.note: No data available for Q2 2025. Tracking began October 2025.

social-capital.note: No data available for Q2 2025. Baseline established October 2025.

phi.note: No data available for Q2 2025. Tracking began October 2025.

revenue.note:
June value (59.3). Recovery quarter with significant volatility: spiked to 91.2 in April (shareholder purchase), dropped to 41.4 in May (standard operations), settled at 59.3 by June. Averaged 64.0 across quarter, showing 6.5% improvement vs Q1 ending.

**Rebase note (added 2026-04-25):** PWI was rebased after this report was published. Values here reflect the original-publication scale. Under the new baseline (Mar 2026 = 100, where 1 PWI point = $376.24 net worth), Q2 2025's ending value of 59.3 corresponds to 7.9 on the new scale. See the Q1 2026 report for the rebase rationale.

completion-rate.note: June value (10 points: 1 book, 7 films). Consistent engagement with strong monthly average of 12 points. April (12 points: 3 books, 3 films), May peaked at 14 points (1 book, 11 films - heavy film consumption), June ended at 10 points. Slight decline from Q1 ending but sustained high engagement.

highlights: PPI remained stable at 98.75, consistent productivity through contract work
PWI recovered 6.5% with volatile spike to 91.2 in April (shareholder purchase)
Longform Media Velocity sustained at 12 points/month average (April 12, May 14, June 10)
Quarter marked stabilization after Q1 transition - finding sustainable rhythm
Three indicators (KBER, SCI, PHI) not yet tracking in Q2 period
Contract work intensive period established foundation for future growth

updates.title: Correction: the Health Index does cover this quarter
updates.body:
This report records no Health Index data for Q2 2025 and states that tracking began in October 2025. That was true of PHI-Classic, the index in publication at the time, whose series starts in October 2025.

PHI was rebuilt in July 2026 as PHI 2.0, a four-pillar composite of Recovery, Sleep, Activity and Fitness computed from Mike's Apple Health archive and re-based so 100 equals his 2023 to 2025 normal. That archive reaches back to January 2023, so PHI 2.0 does cover this quarter: April 104.6, May 111.7, June 93.1, averaging 103.13. May was strong on activity and recovery; June gave most of it back on soft sleep.

At 103.13 this is the strongest quarter of 2025 on the rebuilt index. The report reads Q2 as a stabilization quarter on the strength of PPI and PWI alone, and it was also the year's healthiest stretch.

This is a correction rather than a restatement. There was no figure in this report to restate; the report recorded an absence, and the absence no longer holds. PHI 2.0 is dated by the month it measures, so these three months are the three months of the reporting period.
